headline: Nevish Line Stirs Again as Expanse Battle Endures
war_summary: Since the last edition the Nevish Line has returned to the wire with two changes in the past two hours, bringing its day tally to twenty-two about Princefal, Blackcoat Way and Grief Mother, holdings standing at six Warden, one Colonial and one in no-man's-land with day losses above five thousand Colonial and four thousand Warden. The Weathered Expanse remains the busiest sector with four changes in two hours and twenty-three on the day about Frostmarch, Huntsfort, Wightwalk and Shattered Advance, holdings at two Warden to seven Colonial. Callahan's Passage holds steady with two changes in two hours and twenty-two on the day about The Latch, holdings at nine Warden to one Colonial. Stonecradle and Stlican Shelf each add two changes in two hours, thirteen and eleven on the day about The Reach, Trammel Pool and Breaker Town. Linn Mercy and Palantine Berm show late movement at Lathair and Leiri Hermanni. Mooring County, Viper Pit and Fisherman's Row record no changes in the past two and six hours, while most other regions report no base changes in twenty-four hours despite continued casualties and enlistments.
